title: Production Planning Microservice

_meta.purpose: Machine-readable PRD for the Production Planning Microservice (plan-to-produce) flat single-concern microservice foundation; metadata-only scope with explicit non-claims.

goals.scalability: Independent horizontal scaling per ADR-0348 (autosharding/auto-rebalance); tenant- and cell-scoped writes with no shared mutable global state. Foundation scope: metadata-only, no measured scaling evidence.
goals.security: Default-deny tenant isolation via Cedar (ADR-0243) and tenant-as-scope (ADR-0244); no raw credential/PII/secret bytes in the domain. Foundation scope: no runtime authentication.
goals.performance: Per-manifest SLO and capacity targets (ADR-0340) required before any GA claim; async-first eventing on Pulsar. Foundation scope: no measured SLO.
goals.efficiency: FinOps cost attribution (ADR-0344) and flat single-concern crates (ADR-0131/0132) that avoid platform bloat. Foundation scope: no runtime cost telemetry.
goals.reliability: Idempotent metadata operations and rollback-first promotion. Foundation scope: no DR drill evidence.

non_goals: No live MRP engine, finite scheduler, manufacturing execution system, shop-floor dispatch, inventory goods movement, or production confirmation runtime.
No procurement purchase-order creation, warehouse mutation, accounting posting, Workflow execution, statutory filing, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
No SAP, Oracle, or Dynamics production-planning exhaustive parity claim.

acceptance_criteria.given: a product has an approved manufacturing definition before planning
acceptance_criteria.when: the production-planning domain approves the work definition
acceptance_criteria.then: tenant, legal entity, plant, product item, BOM, route, work center, component counts, run minutes, effective date, source refs, approval evidence, idempotency key, state, schema version, and false shop-floor/inventory/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: an approved work definition exists and demand exceeds available supply after safety stock
acceptance_criteria.when: material requirements planning metadata is produced
acceptance_criteria.then: demand, on-hand quantity, scheduled receipts, safety stock, net requirement, lot-sized planned order quantity, horizon, demand source, planning evidence, idempotency key, and false procurement/inventory/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a planned order proposal has material and capacity evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: production order, planned order, work definition, material availability, material remainder, required capacity, capacity remainder, schedule/material/capacity evidence, release-allowed flag, and false shop-floor/inventory/accounting/Workflow/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: untrusted identifiers, source refs, evidence refs, dates, horizons, or quantities enter the production-planning domain
acceptance_criteria.then: prefix-only, traversal, whitespace/control, credential-shaped refs, invalid dates, invalid horizons, zero quantities, missing work-definition approval, missing planned-order proposal, material shortage, and capacity shortage are refused

decision_log.decision: Production Planning enters the enterprise microservice set as a flat plan-to-produce domain crate rather than a monolithic ERP/PP module; SAP PP and manufacturing coverage is mapped through Tenant RBAC parity composition while MRP runtime, shop-floor execution, inventory mutation, procurement POs, accounting posting, Workflow execution, runtime audit emission, and cloud deployment remain explicit non-claims.
